does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You’re somewhere new every week, at different times, on patchy or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was built for that.
does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t pick it.
does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the van — and the card machine you already take payment on.
does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We’ll fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you’re driving to the pitch or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered while you’re driving to the pitch or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Carry on taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Fewer queues, and food ready when they arrive.

steps.title: Get set up and start taking orders in about 15 minutes.
steps.lede: Three things to sort — and two of them just need a photo.
steps.menuBody: Photograph your board or paste it in. Items, prices and extras all come across on their own. You just check they’re right.
steps.scheduleBody: Got it on your website? We’ll read it from there and keep it up to date. If not, photograph that too. You just approve what it finds.
steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR on the van. Orders land on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.

detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the hatch, paid on your own card terminal.
detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.
detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into deals and offer add-ons at checkout to lift the average order.
detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, then sells out automatically.
detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand one out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
detail.advanced_reporting: Break sales down by date range, item and event to see what’s really selling.
detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.
detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see showing order numbers and when they’re ready.
detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.
detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need notice.
detail.time_slot_selection: Customers pick a collection time slot, spreading demand across your service.
detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can’t pick it.
detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
